_.frame: origin on the pin axis; X inboard along the door (left-edge mount, mirror X for a right edge); Y up; Z proud of the face
_.datum: top parts y0 = track underside; bottom parts y0 = sill; hinges y0 = lower end
_.pieces: fix = stays square to the track (pin, wheels, body, roller); a = the flap on the door at -X (or the only door); b = the flap on the door at +X
_.source: Centor E3 product models (STEP) 28 Jun 2024, closed
_.trim: bot_pivot fix cut at y = -0.80 (the channel floor): Centor fixing points below it removed (Ryan, 16 Nov)
